tooltip.carrote_curios.unique: Active in either hand or any accessory slot. Identical effects do not stack.
tooltip.carrote_curios.offhand: Without Curios: hold in either hand to activate.
tooltip.carrote_curios.airborne_carrote: Total damage +6 while airborne; -2 while grounded.
tooltip.carrote_curios.greed_carrote: Loot uses at least Fortune III and Looting III; tools are unchanged.
tooltip.carrote_curios.enchanting_carrot: Enchanting tables use at least 15 bookshelves; XP and lapis are still required.
tooltip.carrote_curios.smelting_carrote: Automatically smelts mined ore drops, preserving Fortune quantities.
tooltip.carrote_curios.flight_carrote: You gain the ability to fly.
tooltip.carrote_curios.helmet_usage: Equip in the head slot. Copies one Carrote from the Carrote slot, then the offhand. Reports Not copied when the selected ability provides no additional effect.
tooltip.carrote_curios.spent: On cooldown until you die carrying this Carrote.
tooltip.carrote_curios.substitute_carrot: Prevents one death and fully heals you. Stays on cooldown until you die carrying it.
tooltip.carrote_curios.helmet_carrote: Copies the ability of one Carrote.
tooltip.carrote_curios.peace_carrote: Prevents natural spawns of ordinary monsters within 32 blocks.
